data.name: Boxing World Simulator
data.detailed_description:
YOU DON’T FIGHT. YOU MAKE THE FIGHTS.

Boxing World Simulator puts you in the corner as a Boxing Promoter, not a boxer. Build a promotion from nothing, sign fighters you believe in, and claw your way from smoky regional halls to the biggest pay-per-view stage in the sport — one contract, one press conference, one gamble at a time.

Every choice ripples outward. Every negotiation, every interview, every scandal you handle (or mishandle) shapes your reputation and your bank balance. Protect your fighters, play the press, or burn it all down chasing the big money fight — the world reacts either way.

RUN THE BUSINESS OF BOXING

• Live out a full My Promoter career, starting from the bottom with nothing but ambition

• Negotiate contracts, purses, and sponsorships in a deep financial system

• Book your boxers into gyms, competing against rival promotions for the best trainers in the business — or build your own gym and develop talent in house

• Fight nights are brought to life through a text-based match engine grounded in real boxing data across every division

• Relationships matter — boxer personalities shape everything, from contract talks to locker room loyalty to how they respond under pressure

• Talk to boxers, run fan events, face the press, and make the calls that define your promotion

• Navigate bribery and scandal driven by the personalities around you

BUILD YOUR OWN BOXING WORLD

• A huge database of fictional boxers, trainers, referees, judges, promotions, sponsors, PPV channels, and governing bodies — 900 boxers and counting, built toward a full, living boxing universe

• Player-driven skill tree progression shaped by the consequences of your decisions

• Progression and regression for boxers and trainers — one bad call can turn a prospect into a washout

• World and regional title belts, full rankings across 9 weight divisions, and a Hall of Fame

BUILT TO BE RESHAPED — FULLY MODDABLE

Nothing in Boxing World Simulator is locked in stone. The entire database — every boxer, trainer, promotion, sponsor, and governing body — is open in a full edit mode, so you can rewrite the world to your liking or build something completely your own. Want to recreate real boxing history under fictional names? Invent your own weight classes and belts? Overhaul the entire roster from scratch? It’s all yours to shape.

On top of that, a fully functional save game editor lets you reach into your career mid-playthrough and update it as you go — adjust stats, fix a fight gone wrong, tweak your finances, or reshape the world around you without starting over.

+++ Much more to discover!
